ac_results.ac: The document states explicitly that Nodes keep serving their active Revision during a Ruralz Control outage and boot Last-Known-Good configuration after a restart, and lists what is unavailable during the outage.
ac_results.note: Summary and 'Behavior during a Ruralz Control outage' (L40-L52) state both behaviors and give a 7-row table of what is unavailable, consistent with pack 8.2 and 8.5.

ac_results.ac: Rolling back a Rollout takes three steps or fewer, shown as ruralz commands or Ruralz Console actions.
ac_results.note: 'Rolling back in three steps' gives three commands (status, `ruralz rollout rollback`, status) and three Ruralz Console actions.

ac_results.ac: Control Stream contains a message table giving each message, its direction, key fields and ACK/NACK semantics, and covers enrollment, mTLS, snapshot plus delta, heartbeat and backpressure.
ac_results.note: The 14-message table has all four columns. Subsections cover Enrollment and mTLS, Snapshot, delta and version skew, and Heartbeat and backpressure. Heartbeat now carries schemaLevels, per pack 8.4.

ac_results.ac: Drift detection defines the reconciliation policy (what is detected, how it is reported, and when it is reverted or alerted).
ac_results.note: The pack section 11 definition is quoted verbatim. The table gives detection, reporting and reconciliation per Drift kind. Related conditions are separated, and the /config/dump comparison is explained.

ac_results.ac: Bundle, Revision and Rollout lifecycle describes Revision signing by Ruralz Control and signature verification by Nodes, consistent with ADR-0017.
ac_results.note: The signing table covers signed content, keys, algorithm, Node verification (RZ-CFG-033), anchor sets and rotation, consistent with pack 8.14. The re-signing and emergency-removal boot extensions are proposed to ADR-0017 through OQ-control-plane-and-gitops-24.

ac_results.ac: Rollout states match the foundation pack exactly: pending, canary, progressing, paused, complete, rolled-back, failed.
ac_results.note: All seven states match in name and meaning. The missing pack 8.3 transitions to `failed` are raised in OQ-control-plane-and-gitops-15.
